description: Implementation of ApplicationClientFactory for Hono's northbound APIs, managing creation and caching of clients and consumers.

classes.name: ApplicationClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing Hono client instances, including telemetry, event, command, and response consumers.

methods.name: createTelemetryConsumer
methods.description: Creates a telemetry message consumer for a specific tenant.

methods.name: createEventConsumer
methods.description: Creates an event message consumer for a specific tenant with message processing callback.

methods.name: getOrCreateCommandClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a command client for a tenant.

methods.name: getOrCreateAsyncCommandClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an asynchronous command client for a tenant.

methods.name: createAsyncCommandResponseConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for asynchronous command responses.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup on disconnection by clearing client caches.
